verdict.rationale: Jan's README states that it can download and run LLMs such as Llama, Gemma, Qwen and GPT-oss from Hugging Face. The docs show how: enter a model's Hugging Face ID (org/model_name) in the Hub search bar, then run it locally on the llama.cpp-powered runtime, with pause/resume support for downloads. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the Hugging Face download flow, and no documentation of which model formats or quantizations are supported beyond GGUF import.
